label: D1: reward just received at S2 while the agent had recently been choosing a1 (evidence to switch to a2)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass at D1 with prev_reward==1; never at GO/D2 or after no reward). Within that, it is near-specific to rewards obtained in state S2: D1 & rewarded & prev_state==2 covers 86% of activations (the remaining 15% are on the first trial of the window where the previous state is outside the window, so not truly misses). It is strongest when the S2 reward is surprising relative to the agent recent choice of a1 (a1 -> S2 rare rewarded, or a1 two trials back), i.e. reward evidence that favors switching to a2; top examples are a1 S2R rewarded followed by a switch to a2. Recorded predicate uses only observed history: dev P 0.70 R 0.63 F1 0.66 mass 0.68. Missed activations are mostly S2 rewards after a run of a2 choices (weaker, often while S1 is hidden-good), and the D1 policy logit is mid-range (near indifferent, -1.5..2.8 bin holds 86% of mass); requiring choice > -2 raises recall to 0.78 / mass 0.83 at lower precision. Does not fire on S1 rewards, unrewarded trials, or confident stays on a2 after repeated S2 rewards.
